dct_title_s: Saint Kitts and Nevis : Waterways (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Water features across the region from OSM. Includes rivers, streams, canals, lakes, ponds, and water bodies tagged with `waterway`, `water`, or `natural=water`. Useful for flood-risk modelling, watershed analysis, and environmental basemap context. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:waterway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:waterway), [Key:water](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:water), [Key:natural](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:natural) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
